title: The Traveling Players
text: A troupe of players on the otherworld road, painted and grinning, putting on a play about your Houses on the back of their wagon. They have the details wrong. Mostly. The bits they have right, no one outside your Houses should know.

options.label: Watch the play about your Houses, and learn what the world thinks of you.

outcomes.text: It is a good play, and you laugh, and learn something about how others see you.

options.label: The best talker corrects them, so the story is told your way.

outcomes.text: They rewrite it on the spot. Word will spread, your way.

options.label: The richest House pays them to make a rival the villain.

outcomes.text: They take the coin and the note gladly. The rival will see the play sooner or later.
